subject: Trouble installing latest version of ggtree

messages.author: b0084e74319ebcb3
messages.subject: Trouble installing latest version of ggtree
parts:
Hello all,

I am having trouble installing the latest version of ggtree. I want to install the latest version because I want to use viewClade for a tree with a collapsed clade (I believe that I need the 1.9.2 version or higher to do that: https://github.com/GuangchuangYu/ggtree/issues/137). I installed ggtre like this: 

source("https://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("BiocInstaller")

However, the latest version I get is '1.8.2'. I also upgraded BiocInstaller beforehand. What I am doing wrong? Is there another way to install the latest version of ggtree? I appreciate any input or help with this issue. Thank you all in advance.

Best,

Laura C.

messages.author: b0084e74319ebcb3
messages.subject: Re: Trouble installing latest version of ggtree
parts:
Apologies, I installed it this way:

source("https://bioconductor.org/biocLite.R")
biocLite("ggtree")

Thanks again!
